articles.title: The Toxic Vengeance of Capital Punishment
articles.summary: Two radical ideas have been introduced into human thought, wrote the novelist and humorist Kurt Vonnegut. One was that “energy and matter are pretty much the same sort of stuff.” That was Einstein. The other was that “revenge is a bad idea.” That was Jesus. We are so wired for vengeance, so trained to retaliate, mused Vonnegut, Jesus must be classed among the revolutionaries. articles.title: Getting Too Little Sleep Makes You Easier to Scam
articles.summary: When Daylight Saving Time (DST) begins each March and the clocks spring forward, people lose an hour of sleep . This sleep deprivation has been linked to a higher rate of fatal car accidents the week after—but that’s not the only lingering effect of lost sleep. A new study published in Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences , where phishing emails were sent to more than 10,000 people, found that the Monday after DST began, people were 13% more likely to click on the links within a suspicious message.
